snippet.title: Synapse
snippet.description:
Welcome to my channel! 
Watch the best League of Legends funny stream moments, memes, funny fails and pro plays from the most entertaining LoL streams all over the world! In every video i'm trying to find the best moments, most streamers allow me to use their twitch.tv content in my video, but if you're a small streamer or just made a good play and want to share, send it to me! synapse744@gmail.com  If the play is good enough, you will see it in the next video ;)

Press Managers for live events: 

Simon Ruhl, Lukas Schücker, Pierre-Christopher Kaluza

Intro Fiora art by Angrydonat: https://angrydonat.deviantart.com/art/PROJECT-Fiora-559855717
